item.title: Shanghai Sets Satellite Internet Goals: 400 Gbps Laser Links, Onboard AI and Direct-to-Phone Access
item.description: A new Shanghai action plan for 2027 to 2030 sets technical goals for satellite internet, from 400 Gbps inter-satellite laser links and onboard AI to consumer terminals that connect phones directly.

item.title: AgiBot G2 Max Goes to Work in JD Logistics' Robotic Warehouse, Handling 80 Boxes an Hour
item.description: AgiBot's new G2 Max is already handling inbound cartons in a JD Logistics goods-to-person warehouse, depalletizing 80 boxes an hour with a success rate above 99%.

item.title: Kuaishou Rolls Out AI Digital Staff That Diagnose Stores and Run Video, Livestreams and After-Sales
item.description: Kuaishou's merchant workbench now offers a team of AI digital staff, from a virtual store manager to video, livestream and after-sales agents, that diagnose a shop and act for the merchant.

item.title: Infinigence AI Builds a Three-Body Character Agent, Halving First-Token Time With Split Inference
item.description: Infinigence AI and Three-Body Universe launched a character agent from the novel. It runs on Infinigence's AgentWorks platform and a split inference setup that cuts first-token time by 51.5%.

item.title: Rock Matrix Open-Sources EdgeRock-4B, Cutting Qwen3.5-4B's 256K KV Cache From 8 GiB to 72 MiB
item.description: Built from Qwen3.5-4B with HKUST and CMU, EdgeRock-4B keeps a fixed 72 MiB KV cache at 256K context and serves 6.42 times the throughput while keeping most of its reasoning scores.

item.title: Cybersecurity Issue Forces a Major New Mexico Hospital to Divert Patients and Close Clinics
item.description: The University of New Mexico Health System told people not to show up at its main hospital in Albuquerque and canceled appointments at more than 30 clinics. The post Cybersecurity Issue Forces a Major New Mexico Hospital to Divert Patients and Close Clinics appeared first on SecurityWeek.
